label: Conditionally assured
definition: Bounded top claim supported subject to named, owned, time-bound conditions; no gate FAIL or UNKNOWN
ceilingRule: Step 2 UNKNOWN severity: US3 → ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED and a condition | Step 3 Coverage: Any domain relevant to the outcome with coverage < 80% for a mandatory claim type → ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED with a coverage condition | Step 4 Bands: B3 → ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED | Step 5 Conditions and confidence: Open Significant weakness → ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED with condition | Step 5 Conditions and confidence: decision confidence < CONF-3 → ≤ CONDITIONALLY_ASSURED

label: Inconclusive
definition: Evidence, method, boundary or definition cannot support any determination
ceilingRule: Step 1 Gates: FAIL ceiling of CG-01, CG-02, CG-11, CG-12; UNKNOWN ceiling of CG-01, CG-05 (registries/gates/critical-gates.csv, derived per AIDCF-016 section 9.4) | Step 2 UNKNOWN severity: US5 → ≤ INCONCLUSIVE for affected outcomes (whole decision if boundary or Capability Instance) | Step 3 Coverage: Capability coverage < 50% → ≤ INCONCLUSIVE

label: Limited
definition: Some sub-claims supported; material limitations, a gate UNKNOWN, or a gate FAIL whose AIDCF-010 ceiling is LIMITED prevent a broader conclusion
ceilingRule: Step 1 Gates: FAIL ceiling of CG-03, CG-04, CG-05, CG-09, CG-10, CG-13, CG-14, CG-15; UNKNOWN ceiling of CG-02, CG-03, CG-04, CG-06, CG-07, CG-08, CG-09, CG-10, CG-11, CG-12, CG-13, CG-14, CG-15 (registries/gates/critical-gates.csv, derived per AIDCF-016 section 9.4) | Step 2 UNKNOWN severity: US4 → ≤ LIMITED for affected outcomes (or the gate's UNKNOWN ceiling if lower) | Step 3 Coverage: < 80% → ≤ LIMITED | Step 4 Bands: B2 → ≤ LIMITED | Step 5 Conditions and confidence: < CONF-2 → ≤ LIMITED

label: Not assured
definition: Evidence demonstrates that the top claim, or a controlling gate, is not met
ceilingRule: Step 1 Gates: FAIL ceiling of CG-06, CG-07, CG-08 (registries/gates/critical-gates.csv, derived per AIDCF-016 section 9.4) | Step 4 Bands: B1 → ≤ NOT_ASSURED

label: Reasonably assured
definition: Sufficient appropriate evidence supports the bounded top claim; all applicable gates PASS or APPROVED_NA; no undisposed US3 or higher UNKNOWN
ceilingRule: No ceiling: starting state of the AIDCF-010 Part XII derivation
